name: netrunner-trace
description: A live node map of every host your agent reaches: packets fly from your machine to github.com, npm, PyPI, MCP servers and unknown hosts, with a log and first-contact alerts

allowedHosts.title: Expected hosts
allowedHosts.description: Comma- or space-separated hosts you expect the agent to reach. Subdomains count. Anything else is drawn red. Added to the built-in list (GitHub, npm, PyPI, crates.io, Go proxy, RubyGems, Homebrew, Docker Hub, CocoaPods, Anthropic).

showTicker.title: Ticker above the prompt
showTicker.description: Show the last few hosts in a one-line ticker above the prompt.
